description: Subscribe an email to the Tick Mark Books digest of new and freshly re-verified tools. Provide an email; returns { ok }. The address gets one mail with a link to confirm, and is on the list only once the person at that address uses it, within 7 days. Signups from hosting and VPN networks are refused. Every issue carries a one-click unsubscribe.
